content.title: Practice and Preparation – SAT Suite
content.text: Whether you're taking the SAT on a weekend or school day, PSAT/NMSQT, PSAT 10, or PSAT 8/9, find your free practice resources here. Getting Started If you're new to the official practice resources available to you, use the pages below to start exploring. Build Your Study Plan Our recommended study activities will help you get ready, no matter how much time you have before test day. Get Started Take a Practice Test Download Bluebook to take official digital practice tests, and learn helpful strategies to prepare for adaptive testing. Start Practicing My Practice 101 Find your practice test scores, print a practice score report to share with your counselor, and more in My Practice. Read Overview Study Tips Check out our best advice to take your practice to the next level. Maximize Your Practice Tests Taking a full-length practice test is a big commitment. Here's how to get the most out of the experience so you're ready for test day. See Practice Test Ideas Study with Khan Academy® Read more about how to use the free lessons and quizzes on Khan Academy to review important skills and improve challenge areas. Review Study Tips Focus on Skills with the Student Question Bank Learn how to customize your practice and build specific skills using targeted questions. Start Now Practice with Confidence These confidence-boosting study activities can empower you to walk into your testing room feeling prepared. Find Practice Exercises Fun and Fast Practice Introducing Question of the Day Question of the Day is a fun and fast way to check your knowledge. The content comes from the makers of the SAT Suite of Assessments, so you can answer official questions in a casual setting that makes learning feel like a game. Resources Ready to jump in? These links will bring you directly to our practice resources. SAT Practice for Students Download these resources to explore the free tools and support available to help you feel confident and prepared for the SAT. Bluebook Practice Tests Take a free, full-length practice test on Bluebook, or try a few sample questions in the test preview. My Practice Access the Student Question Bank, view your practice results, and try out practice-specific questions tailored to your results. Official SAT Prep on Khan Academy® Official SAT Prep on Khan Academy will make a study plan for students, giving them the preparation that will benefit them the most for test day. Student Guides These guides provide helpful information for students taking the SAT Suite of Assessments. Download and learn what to expect ahead of test day.
